page.layout: Printed page 71 on one scan. Running text in one column, with the continuation of the previous page at the top, then a title block (TARTARICA, Periodus I., Canon I.) and a short paragraph, then a paragraph with a large initial. Marginal notes stand in the right margin, beside the title and the paragraphs. The left edge of the scan shows the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: tyrannidem A C 1648. repetierunt, pari licentia strangulato Imperatore suo Ibrahimo sive Abrahamo. Unde omnis Imperii Turcici potestas penes Janitzaro[?] sive Milites Praetorianos hodie sita est: ex quo langvor iste, ut per tot annos Cretam sive Candiam, Insulam Maris Mediterranei, Venetis eripere non potuerint. Hodie Turcis praeest Mahumetes IV.
main_text.head: TARTARICA.3. Tartarica,
Periodus I.
main_text.p: Circa A.C. 1200 quidam Faber ferrarius, vel, ut alii volunt, Bubulcus, Scythis ad arma concitatis, & debellato Iohanne, Imperatore Nestoriano, amplissimum circa Sinam(1) Ortus. DIm-

page.notes: The large initial "D" of the last paragraph is set as a large letter; the joined word after it, "Im-", is read as "Im-" and the full word is cut off at the scan edge, so the joined form "DIm-" is uncertain. Also uncertain: "Janitzaro" (final letter hidden in the fold). Printed page number "71" is set as "7" with a superscript; read as 71. The number "1200" uses old-style figures and is copied as printed. Show-through text from the other side of the leaf is faint behind the title and is not transcribed. The marginal note "3. Tartarica," stands beside the heading, "Regni Tartarici" beside the line "Tartari universa", and "(1) Ortus." beside "Circa".
